ideas.title: Following the Money in Minnesota's Feeding Our Future Fraud Case
ideas.description: Investigate the financial transactions and money trail in the Feeding Our Future fraud case to identify potential co-conspirators and uncover the full extent of the scheme.
questions: Who were the main beneficiaries of the fraud scheme?
How did the perpetrators launder the money?
ideas.insight: By analyzing the financial transactions and identifying the money trail, we can uncover the full extent of the scheme and potentially identify other co-conspirators.
